name: MAHLE
verdict: MAHLE is 99.9% owned by the MAHLE Foundation. Nothing found.
note: Technical partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to mahle.com, stands under 'Technical partners' with the line 'Engine components' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): the MAHLE Foundation has held 99.9% of the company since 1964, and MABEG the other 0.1% with the voting rights (mahle-foundation-ownership). No state or state-fund shareholder. No human-rights finding against the company found.
